objective: Small paired pilot of the complete DART representation pipeline against ordinary flat-text chunking; not a structure-only causal test.

arms.generic: lxml HTML text extraction preserving all visible text nodes; recursive 2500 character chunks with 320 overlap; common report metadata
arms.dart: Current local v12 FinancialParser, canonical structural selective v2 prefix 2500/320, source context metadata; no model preprocessing

fixed.retrieval: Exact squared L2 dense top24 + BM25 positive top24; RRF60 final top12; same unmodified query; no expansion/reranker
fixed.packet_policy: Whole source only in ranked order; omit overflowing sources, do not truncate
fixed.generation: Existing ANSWER_INSTRUCTIONS and RagAnswer schema, direct Responses harness, same wire for both arms

order: Per question repeat1 generic then dart; repeat2 dart then generic. Embeddings once per corpus and shared query embeddings.

evaluation.numeric: Both requested operands, correct scope, unit, period and calculation; ratio tolerance 0.01 percentage point, amounts within half last displayed unit only; no contradictory material claim
evaluation.narrative: Required source-derived business segments and representative product or service per segment, no contradiction; rubric fixed before retrieval
evaluation.negative: Explicit insufficient daily evidence and abstained true; no fabricated daily amount
evaluation.faithfulness: All material answer claims supported by visible supplied documents and cited sources; citation membership alone is not semantic support
evaluation.denominators: 8 answerable questions x2 repeats per arm, 2 negative controls x2 separately. Repeats are not independent questions.

stops: First transport/HTTP/schema/identity error, no retry or model fallback
No post-result tuning, question replacement or adoption
limits: New project evaluation reports, not guaranteed absent from model training
Same assistant authors rubric and reviews answers; no independent blind judge
Pipeline comparison includes extraction, boundaries and context metadata jointly
Small two-company sample is descriptive only
